title: "[Sift seed] Add a visible rules-bot mode badge"
labels: sift:run,sift:seed,priority:p2
---

Add a small, accessible UI label that clearly says the game uses fictional rules bots and needs no API key. Keep the change limited to presentation and add a focused test.

Acceptance criteria:
- The badge is visible on the playable screen.
- It does not claim to use a paid or live runtime model.
- Existing gameplay behavior remains unchanged.
